2607.25728.title: Shared Voxel-Map-Based Cooperative Indoor UAV Guidance with a Multi-Agent Soft Actor-Critic Controller
2607.25728.paper_summary: This paper presents a cooperative indoor UAV guidance framework that combines a shared voxel-map world model with a multi-agent Soft Actor-Critic (MASAC) controller. Multiple drones fuse 360 LiDAR observations into a common world-frame occupancy map, which is converted into a compact bird's-eye-view (BEV) representation and provided to each agent as an ego-aligned local crop. This integrate-in-world, act-in- ego design enables consistent multi-UAV spatial fusion whilst retaining decentralised continuous control. The policy combines BEV map features, near-field obstacle observations, and compact goal and peer-state information within a centralised-training, decentralised-execution framework. In simulation, the learned controller achieves a 90.3% success rate in corridor navigation, outperforming Astar planning, an artificial potential field controller, and a prior guidance method. To address residual sim-to-real mismatch, the simulation-trained policy is further adapted using offline imitation fine-tuning from real-world data. Real-world experiments in GNSS-denied indoor environments demonstrate stable two-UAV cooperative operation across increasingly chal- lenging obstacle layouts. The results show that shared voxel-map representations provide an effective and scalable spatial substrate for learned cooperative indoor UAV guidance.
2607.25728.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文提出了一個合作的室內無人機引導框架，該框架結合了共享的體素地圖世界模型與多代理軟演員-評論者（MASAC）控制器。多架無人機將360度LiDAR觀測數據融合成一個共同的世界框架佔用地圖，該地圖被轉換為緊湊的鳥瞰圖（BEV）表示，並作為自我對齊的局部裁剪提供給每個代理。這種在世界中整合、在自我中行動的設計使得多無人機空間融合的一致性得以保持，同時保留去中心化的連續控制。該策略結合了BEV地圖特徵、近場障礙物觀測以及在集中訓練、去中心化執行框架內的緊湊目標和同伴狀態信息。在模擬中，學習到的控制器在走廊導航中達到了90.3%的成功率，超越了A星規劃、一種人工勢場控制器以及先前的引導方法。為了解決殘餘的模擬與現實不匹配，模擬訓練的策略進一步通過來自現實世界數據的離線模仿微調進行適應。在無GNSS的室內環境中的實驗顯示，兩架無人機的合作操作在日益挑戰的障礙布局中保持穩定。結果表明，共享的體素地圖表示提供了一種有效且可擴展的空間基礎，用於學習的合作室內無人機引導。
